name: copenhagen side plank
description: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench and the bottom leg hanging free. It builds strong inner thighs and side core.
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench with your forearm under your shoulder.
Place the inside of your top foot or knee on the bench.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Keep the bottom leg off the floor if you can.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.
